note: Byte limits for the prose this package ships — DESIGN-RECORD §24.5. A limit may fall freely (npm run budget:relock) and is never raised by a script: a raise is typed by hand and its why names the section that justifies it. The test also fails when a file is more than slack bytes under its limit, so a cut is locked in by the commit that earns it.
